clog-1: Amanzi asendlini yangasese awehli nhlobo futhi ayachichima
clog-2: Kuwe into engaziwa (i-wet wipe, ibhulashi lamazinyo, isivalo) endlini yangasese
clog-3: Usinki wasekhishini unuka kabi futhi amanzi ayama
clog-4: Amanzi ayachichima ephayipheni elingaphansi kukasinki noma ephayipheni laphansi
clog-5: Ipayipi laphansi lasegunjini lokugezela livinjwe izinwele futhi liyachichima
clog-6: Ipayipi legumbi lokuwasha / lovulandi likhipha amagwebu namanzi
clog-7: Ipayipi elikhulu lokukhuculula indle lwesakhiwo noma umgodi wendle uvaliwe
clog-9: Kudingeka ukuhlanzwa nokuvulwa kwamapayipi ngomshini wamanzi anomfutho ophezulu
clog-10: Izinkinga zepayipi elixhuma kuthangi lendle nokubuyela kwamanzi emuva
clog-11: Umgodi wokuchitha ukudla uvinjwe ngamafutha agxilile
clog-12: Ukuhlanzwa kwesicupho samafutha sendawo yokudlela nokuvula amapayipi
leak-1: Amanzi ayaconsa noma amanzisa uphahla/udonga lwendlu engezansi
leak-2: Imitha yamanzi iyaphenduka noma kungekho manzi asetshenziswayo
leak-3: Iphepha lodonga, iphansi leplanka, noma ucansi kumswakama futhi kunokhunta
leak-5: Isisekelo sendlu yangasese noma izingxenye zethangi lendlwana ziyavuza
leak-6: Amakhaza asebusika aqhekeze iphayipi lamanzi noma imitha liqandekile
leak-7: Amanzi anomhlwa obomvu noma inhlabathi/ukungcola kuphuma empompini
leak-8: Amaphayipi e-boiler noma ivalvu yokusabalalisa ukufudumala iyavuza
leak-9: Amanzi emvula angena emfantwini yangaphandle noma ezivalweni zamafasitela
leak-10: Kudingeka ukutholwa kokuvuza okuncane ngobuchwepheshe bomsindo/begesi
leak-11: Umfutho wamanzi uphansi kakhulu, kudingeka ukufakwa kwepompo yokukhulisa umfutho
leak-12: Ukushintshwa ngokuphelele kwamapayipi amadala nokuvikela iphansi lokugezela emanzini
bl-1: Ugesi we-boiler uvuliwe, kodwa igumbi alifudumali nhlobo
bl-2: Awekho amanzi ashisayo ngesikhathi sokugeza, kuphuma amanzi abandayo kuphela
bl-4: Amanzi aconsa ngaphakathi kwebhoyila noma kumapayipi angezansi
bl-5: Umsindo omkhulu wokungqongqoza noma wokubhonga lapho ibhoyila iqala ukusebenza
bl-6: Iphunga legesi noma intuthu yomoya engcolile ingena ekamelweni
bl-7: Ukwehluleka kwepompo lokujikeleza; kukhala amanzi kuphela kodwa akukho ukufudumala
bl-8: Isicelo senani lebhoyila yegesi entsha ye-condensing evikela imvelo
bl-9: I-thermostat yegumbi ngalinye yephukile noma i-actuator yesona ayisebenzi kahle
bl-10: Ukuhlanza ipayipi lokufudumeza (ukukhipha udaka) nokukhipha umoya kuyadingeka
bl-11: Ukuhlolwa nokulungiswa kwebhoyila kawoyela / kagesi / yamalahle
bl-12: Ukuncibilikisa amapayipi ebhoyila afriziwe nokufaka kabusha izinto zokuvikela amakhaza
clean-2: Ukukhipha amafutha amaningi esitofini sasekhishini/i-hood nosinki
clean-3: Ukubulala isikhunta phakathi kwama-tile okugeza, i-limescale nokuhlanza ngokujulile indlu yangasese
clean-4: Ukuhlanza uthuli kuma-frame efasitela, inetha lezinambuzane nokuhlanza izingilazi zombili
clean-5: Ukuhlakaza ingaphakathi lesiqandisi ukuhlanza ngesitimu nokususa iphunga lokudla
clean-6: Ukuhlakaza i-air conditioner ukuhlanza isihlungi nokukhipha isikhunta kuma-fin apholisayo
clean-7: Ukuhlakaza ubhavu womshini wokuwasha ukuhlanza ngokujulile nokukhipha amabala aqinile
clean-8: Ukukhuhla phansi ngomshini, ukukhipha amabala nokugcoba i-wax evikelayo
clean-9: Ukukhipha izimbuzane zothuli kumatilasi/osofa bendwangu nokuhlanza okumanzi okujulile
clean-10: Ukuhlanza indlu egcwele udoti omningi (Ukulahlwa kwenqwaba kadoti nokususa iphunga)
clean-11: Ukuhlanza ngemuva kokwakha (Ukususa uthuli lukasimende namabala kapende)
clean-12: Ukususa uboya bezilwane/iphunga lokungcola nokufafaza i-phytoncide evikela imvelo
h-1: I-studio ethengekayo enediphozithi ephansi ye-1M~3M KRW
h-2: Ifulethi elivulekele abanamakhadi okubhalisa abokufika nama-visa asemthethweni
h-3: Okugcwele (Umshini wokuwasha, Isiqandisi, i-A/C, Isitofu/Induction kufakiwe)
h-4: Ukuqashwa kwesikhathi esifushane (izinyanga ezi-3 kuye kwezi-6) istudio/gosiwon
h-5: Indlu enamagumbi amabili noma amathathu yokwabelana nozakwethu/umndeni
h-6: Kungakapheli imizuzu engu-5 uhamba ngezinyawo eya esitimeleni noma ebhasini
h-7: Izindleko zokugcina kanye nezinsiza ezisobala nezingabizi kakhulu
h-8: Indawo yokupaka kanye nekheshi kukhona esakhiweni sesimanje
h-9: Indawo ehlala izilwane ezifuywayo (izinja, amakati avunyelwe)
h-10: Ukudluliswa kwenkontileka kusenesikhathi & nosizo lokubuyisela idiphozithi
bank-1: Ukuphelezelwa kokuvula i-akhawunti yasebhange nge-ARC / Iphasipoti
bank-2: Ukufaka isicelo sekhadi lasebhange elinomsebenzi wokuhamba we-T-money
bank-3: Ibhange leselula laku-inthanethi, isitifiketi sedijithali & nokusetha i-OTP
bank-4: Ukwandisa umkhawulo wokuthumela imali phesheya & nokubhalisa i-akhawunti
bank-5: Ukukhipha kabusha ibhuku lasebhange/ikhadi elilahlekile & nokuphrinta izitatimende
bank-6: Ukusetha kabusha amaphutha ephasiwedi izikhathi ezi-5 & nokuvula i-akhawunti emisiwe
bank-7: Ukuqoka i-akhawunti yeholo & nokusetha ukudonswa kwemali okuzenzakalelayo
bank-8: Ukubheka ukufaneleka kwekhadi lesikweletu labokufika & nosizo lwamaphepha
insur-1: Ukuhlola ukufaneleka kwe-Inshwalense Yezempilo Kazwelonke & nokuphelezelwa ekubhaliseni
insur-2: Iminshwalense eyisibopho yabasebenzi bangaphandle (Isiqinisekiso sokuhamba / Ingozi)
insur-3: Ukubonisana ngomshuwalense wangasese wezokwelapha & nokulaliswa esibhedlela
insur-4: Ukusetha umshwalense ophoqelekile & ophelele wemoto / wesithuthuthu
insur-5: Ukuholwa ngokufaka isimangalo somshwalense & nokuhunyushwa kwemibhalo yezokwelapha
insur-6: Izinguquko zomshwalense ngenxa ye-visa & nokubuyiselwa kwemali yesivumelwano
insur-7: Ukubonisana ngohlelo lomshwalense wamazinyo, umdlavuza & nokuhlinzwa okukhulu
insur-8: Ukubuza & nokuqoqa izinzuzo zomshwalense ezingabizwanga ngaphambi kokubuyela ekhaya
job-1: Ezokukhiqiza / Ukukhiqiza nasefemini nokuhlanganisa (Kunikezwa indawo yokulala)
job-2: Umsizi wasekhishini lendawo yokudlela / Umphakeli / Umpheki (Abokufika bamukelekile)
job-3: Ezokwakha / Isayithi lokulungisa izindlu: ukubaza, izinsimbi, ugesi nokufakwa kwamapayipi
job-4: Ukuhweba / Indawo yokugcina impahla: ukungenisa nokukhipha, ukushayela iforklift nokupakisha
job-5: Ukuhumusha / Ezokuphatha ehhovisi / Uchwepheshe wezokukhangisa emhlabeni jikelele
job-6: Ukubuyekezwa kwenkontileka yomsebenzi (Iholo, amahora okusebenza, imishwalense emikhulu engu-4 yomphakathi)
job-7: Ukuphelezelwa ekubonisaneni ngokomthetho ngamaholo angakhokhiwe, imali yokushiya umsebenzi nezingxabano zabasebenzi
job-8: Abaqashi: Ukuqashwa kwezisebenzi zangaphandle ezisemthethweni, ezikhuthele nezithembekile
hosp-1: Ukubhukha isikhathi sokubonana nodokotela nokubhalisa esibhedlela jikelele/sasenyuvesi
hosp-2: Ukuhumusha nokuphelezelwa ngokwelashwa kwamazinyo, umsuka wezinyo, nokukhishwa kwezinyo
hosp-3: Ukuhunyushwa kwengxenye yamathambo: amathambo aphukile, ubuhlungu beqolo, nokwelashwa ngokomzimba
hosp-4: Umuthi wangaphakathi / ENT: imikhuhlane, ukusha kwesisu, nokuhunyushwa kokuhlolwa ngombhobho (endoscopy)
hosp-5: Ukuhlolwa kwe-OB-GYN / Urology nokubonisana ngasese nodokotela
hosp-6: Incazelo yombiko wokuhlolwa kwezempilo kazwelonke ngolimi lwakho lwebele
hosp-7: Ukuphelezelwa nosizo oluphuthumayo egumbini labagula kakhulu (ER) ebusuku noma ngezimpelasonto
mob-1: Ukwenza kusebenze i-USIM yezindleko eziphansi yabokufika enokuqinisekiswa okugcwele komazisi
mob-2: Ukugcwalisa kabusha okusheshayo kwe-SIM ekhokhelwa kusengaphambili nezinhlelo zedatha engapheli
mob-3: Ukubhalisa okusha kwezinkampani ezinkulu zokuxhumana (SKT/KT/LGU+) nokuthuthukela kuma-smartphone akamuva
mob-4: Ukufakwa kwe-inthanethi ye-fiber esheshayo ne-Giga Wi-Fi yesitudiyo/yekhaya
mob-5: Ukuxazulula ukumiswa ngenxa yezikweletu, ukudlulisa ubunikazi nokushintsha inethiwekhi ugcine inombolo (MNP)
mob-6: Ukufakwa kohlelo lokusebenza lokuqinisekisa umazisi lwe-PASS nosizo lokuqinisekisa kumaselula
mob-7: Umonakalo wesikrini, ukushintshwa kwebhethri nokuphelezelwa esikhungweni esisemthethweni sesevisi
mob-8: Izinhlelo zokusebenza zezingcingo zaphesheya ezinesaphulelo nokuthenga amakhuphoni edatha ekhokhelwa kusengaphambili
